rubric.text: Suspects lost/restored tracing state across helper teardown rather than accepting zero as improved performance; rejects nested-rule workaround.
Proposes a rule-helper-rule regression in one process with UI assertions, independent unkeyed counters, and an expected too-tight budget failure; keeps Android coverage across supported BOMs.

provenance.normalization_note: Authored source excerpts and supplied observations; not a claim of an executed UI fixture.
